patterns: Tell me how to start my application
How do I get started with my EMU application?
responses: To apply to EMU, visit [emu.edu/apply](https://emu.edu/apply), create an account, and fill out the online application. It’s free and easy to complete!
Start your EMU application online at [emu.edu/apply](https://emu.edu/apply). You’ll need to provide transcripts and a few details about yourself.

patterns: When is the deadline to apply?
Is there a deadline for EMU applications?
responses: EMU has rolling admissions, but it's recommended to apply by March 1 for priority scholarship consideration.
There’s no hard deadline, but applying earlier ensures better access to scholarships and housing.

patterns: What do I need to get in?
Do I need SAT or ACT?
responses: EMU is test-optional! A strong high school GPA and your transcript are the main factors considered. Learn more at [emu.edu/admissions/requirements](https://emu.edu/admissions/requirements).
A good academic record and personal character are most important. You can apply without SAT/ACT scores if you prefer.

patterns: Is it hard to get into EMU?
responses: EMU has an acceptance rate of around 60-70%. We value students who are motivated and ready to make a difference.
EMU is moderately selective. If you're serious about your education and community, you have a good shot.

patterns: I'm a transfer student, how do I apply?
Is the process different for transfers?
responses: Transfer students apply using the same online application but must also submit transcripts from all colleges attended. Learn more at [emu.edu/transfer](https://emu.edu/transfer).
Yes, transfers are welcome! We’ll work with you to make sure your credits transfer smoothly.

patterns: Do I have to pay to apply?
Is there an EMU application cost?
How much is the application fee?
responses: EMU’s undergraduate application is completely free!
There’s no cost to apply — the EMU application is free for all students.

patterns: How do I check my application status?
Where can I see my admission decision?
responses: Log in to your EMU applicant portal to check your status. You’ll get email updates too!
To view your application progress, visit your EMU application portal or contact the admissions office for help.

patterns: I need to talk to EMU admissions
responses: You can reach EMU Admissions by calling 800-368-2665 or emailing admissions@emu.edu.
Visit [emu.edu/admissions](https://emu.edu/admissions) to find contact details and connect with an admissions counselor.
